title: Engine fell off UPS cargo plane before deadly crash near Kentucky airport
summary: Aircraft crashed shortly after takeoff from Louisville international airport, killing at least nine and injuring 11 A federal investigator said a UPS cargo plane’s left wing caught fire and an engine fell off shortly before it crashed and exploded into a huge fireball in Louisville, Kentucky, on Tuesday night, killing at least nine people and injuring 11. At least 28 National Transportation Safety Board agents arrived at the site and began searching for clues about the possible cause of the disaster, which saw the UPS plane crash shortly after takeoff at the Louisville Muhammad Ali international airport, leaving behind a fiery trail of destruction on the ground and a huge plume of black smoke. title: Floppy disks get a second life at Cambridge University Library
summary: A new program at the University of Cambridge library in the UK is asking people to bring in their floppy disks so that any digital artifacts on them can be extracted. Among rediscovered files are documents once belonging to Stephen Hawking, says technical analyst Leontien Talboom.

title: DoorDash reports more orders than expected in third quarter, but warns of higher expenses ahead
summary: DoorDash reported higher-than-expected orders and revenue in the third quarter but warned investors that it will be spending significantly more on product development next year. The San Francisco-based delivery company said Wednesday its total orders rose 21% to 776 million in the July-September period. title: A new ion-based quantum computer makes error correction simpler
summary: The US- and UK-based company Quantinuum today unveiled Helios, its third-generation quantum computer, which includes expanded computing power and error correction capability.
